onChange.script:
# name of an associated data property changed
	
	newName = currentValue.value
	oldName = self.view.params.rowData.propName['value']
	
	if newName != oldName and str(origin) not in ['Binding','Script']:

		# creating a list of names that are not allowed for associated data properties
		forbiddenNames = ['name','enabled','priority','timestampSource',
							'label','displayPath','ackMode','notes','ackNotesReqd',
							'shelvingAllowed','mode','setpointA','inclusiveA','anyChange',
							'setpointB','inclusiveB','bitPosition','bitOnZero','isActive',
							'deadband','deadbandMode','timeOnDelaySeconds','timeOffDelaySeconds',
							'ackPipeline','activePipeline','clearPipeline','voip_customMessage',
							'CustomEmailMessage','CustomEmailSubject','CustomSmsMessage','Name',
							'Enabled','Priority','Timestamp Source','Label','Display Path','Ack Mode',
							'Notes','Ack Notes Required','Shelving Allowed','Mode','Setpoint',
							'Inclusive','Any Change','Deadband','Deadband Mode','Active delay (seconds)',
							'Clear delay (seconds)','Low Setpoint','Low Inclusive','High Setpoint',
							'High Inclusive','Any Change','Bit Position','On Zero','Is Active',
							'Ack Pipeline','Active Pipeline','Clear Pipeline','Custom Message',
							'Custom Subject','activeCondition']
		
		# also adding the names of the other associated data properties (for this 
		# alarm) to the list
		for associatedData in self.view.params.rowData.adNames:
			forbiddenNames.append(associatedData)
		
		# checking to see if the new name is in the list of forbidden names
		idx = -1
		for index,name in enumerate(forbiddenNames):
			if newName == name:
				idx = index
				break
		
		# if index is not -1 and the new name is not equal to the old name, then a
		# forbidden name was entered (notify the user via popup)
		if idx != -1 and newName != oldName:
			# forbidden names list has 60 names to start; if the idx var is greater
			# than 59, then we know that the alarm already has an associated data 
			# with the same name
			if idx > 59:
				body = 'This alarm already has an associated data called ' + newName + '. Please use a different name.'
			else:
				body = newName + ' is a reserved name. Please use a different name.'
				
			system.perspective.openPopup("change-associated-data-name",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'title':'Error','body':body,'id':'change-associated-data-name'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
			self.props.text = oldName
		
		# non-forbidden name was entered, send a message to propChange containing the new name	
		elif newName != oldName:
			payload = {'propName':oldName,'propVal':newName,'adNameChange':0}
			
			logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.adnamecell')
			logger.debug('associated data name changed; old name= ' + oldName + '; new name= ' + newName)
			
			system.perspective.sendMessage("propChange",payload=payload,scope="page")
		
		# removing focus from the text field	
		self.parent.focus()
